description: Use this FIRST when the user asks where to work, study or take calls in Las Vegas/Henderson/Summerlin (e.g. "quiet café with outlets near the Strip, open late"). Returns the top spots for that need, ranked by a deterministic score over Remote Vegas's hand-checked data, with a short reason for each pick. Understands quiet/focus, calls, outlets, Wi-Fi, open late/now, free, coffee vs hotel lobby vs library, and zone names written in the text. Not for places outside the Las Vegas valley.

need.description: The user's need in plain words, e.g. "quiet place with outlets for 2 hours of calls near summerlin, open late"

open_at.description: Optional time to be open: ISO datetime (no offset = Vegas local) or "sat 14:00"

zone.description: Zone slug, name or alias: a quadrant (central, northwest, northeast, southwest, southeast), an area (e.g. the-strip, downtown, arts-district, chinatown, summerlin, henderson) or a landmark waypoint. See list_zones.

name: recommend_spot
title: Recommend where to work in Las Vegas
